skills.name: It’s Time You Gave Up
skills.description: Enslaved Yuuki appears and roars, giving good effects to allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +30% (8 sec) *Move Speed +130% (8 sec)

skills.name: Mighty Blade Cross
skills.description: Kyouka and enslaved Yuuki team up and attack enemies in a cross shape. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy buffs (6 sec) *Enemy Skill Resistance -60% (6 sec) *ATK x 3600% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: Chained Soldier
abilities.description: Chained Soldier Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Skill Barrier 2
abilities.description: Continuously provides a barrier that greatly protects against Skill Damage. - The Skill Barrier disappears after blocking Skill Damage 1 time and is reapplied 1 second later. - The Skill Barrier remains intact when Skill Damage is reduced to 0 through invincibility. - Boss, Guardian, and special type enemies' Skill Damage cannot be blocked.
